description: This file handles AJAX requests to set IP configuration on a device. It includes functions for IP validation, processes incoming JSON configuration data, and sets system configuration parameters accordingly.

methods.name: isValidIP
methods.description: Validates if the provided IP address is within a specified range.

methods.name: ipRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end IP addresses for a subnet given the gateway address and subnet mask.

methods.name: valid_GW_IP
methods.description: Checks if a gateway IP address falls within a specified begin and end address range.

methods.name: isValidGW
methods.description: Validates if the gateway IP address and subnet configuration are within acceptable ranges for private networks.
